value.summary: Lando NORRIS (NOR) proved the stronger driver overall, edging Max VERSTAPPEN (VER) in the head-to-head tally (2 wins to 1), finishing on average 2.667 places ahead of VER’s 9 places and gaining 1.333 positions per race. NOR also posted a faster race pace of 95.78 s/lap versus VER’s 96.169 s/lap and was quicker by 0.389 s per lap on average. VER showed advantages in tyre management (-0.018 s/lap vs 0.048 s/lap) and overtaking (6 overtakes to 5). The comparison is limited by the fact that VER did not finish one of the three races, which drags down his result and pace averages.
